summary: [correctness] A Postgres DSN that is set but MALFORMED or EMPTY is answered RETENTION_TIERS_UNAVAILABLE (exit 2, retryable true). pg_tier.rs maps every sqlx connect error to StoreError::tier_unreachable (configured: true) and tiers.rs treats any set DSN env var as 'unreachable'. Real binary: CANON_PG_DSN='not a dsn' and CANON_PG_DSN='' (set, empty) with a postgres hot tier, export --kind session --output out.json: RETENTION_TIERS_UNAVAILABLE retryable true, message 'error with configuration: relative URL without a base' (sqlx::Error::Configuration). Waiting never fixes that; an agent that follows retryable repeats forever. Only a connect that failed on the network or the server (Io, Tls, PoolTimedOut, a rejected login) is 'set and cannot be reached'. The unreachable cases are right: 127.0.0.1:1 and no-such-host.invalid both answer UNAVAILABLE. Fix: in PgTier::connect (and the lenient builder) keep sqlx::Error::Configuration (and an empty DSN, which is unset) as tier_unavailable / a Policy error so it answers RETENTION_TIERS_REQUIRED or _INVALID (not retryable), add a malformed and an empty DSN case to atip_reasons_14.
